item.title: Lilly in talks to acquire Ventyx Biosciences for over $1 billion
item.description: Eli Lilly is in advanced talks to acquire Ventyx Biosciences for over $1 billion, which would add drugs for inflammatory bowel diseases, Parkinson's, and cardiovascular diseases to its pipeline.

item.title: Indiana’s Curt Cignetti and Oregon’s Dan Lanning set for coaching showdown
item.description: Indiana coach Curt Cignetti and Oregon coach Dan Lanning, both former Alabama assistants, will face off in the College Football Playoff semifinals. Each brings their own unique coaching styles and mutual admiration for each other.

item.title: Appeals court rules against Satanic Temple in Indiana abortion ban challenge
item.description: The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit unanimously dismissed a lawsuit brought by the Satanic Temple against Indiana's 2022 near-total ban on abortions, ruling that the Satanic Temple lacked standing to bring its claims.

item.title: St. John’s outscores Butler by 14 in second half for Big East win
item.description: St. John's defeated Butler 84-70 on Tuesday, led by Zuby Ejiofor's 18 points, five rebounds, and three steals. Finley Bizjack led the Bulldogs in scoring, finishing with 21 points.

item.title: Eastern Michigan dominates Ball State with 74-52 win in Muncie
item.description: Eastern Michigan beat Ball State 74-52 on Tuesday, led by Carlos Hart's 18 points and Addison Patterson's 12 points.

item.title: Bowing to Cavaliers, Pacers set NBA franchise record: 13-game losing streak
item.description: Indiana, the defending Eastern Conference champs, lost its 13th straight to set a franchise record in its NBA era. The Pacers are now a league-worst 6-31 and are one loss away from matching the Washington Wizards' 14-game skid for the league's longest skid this season.

item.title: Firefighters, animal hospital save kitten trapped in metal sewer grate
item.description: Firefighters and an animal hospital rescued a 5-month-old kitten that had its head stuck in a metal sewer grate in Indianapolis.

item.title: INDOT cancels numerous road projects amid funding shortfall concerns
item.description: Indiana Department of Transportation has canceled hundreds of road and bridge projects due to funding constraints, while still pursuing a billion-dollar road project in southern Indiana. The state agency also is considering tolling as a potential revenue source.

item.title: Martial arts instructor turns pain into purpose after violent attack
item.description: James Clingerman, a Gracie jiu-jitsu national champion, overcame a tragic shooting that left him with permanent scars and almost complete blindness in his left eye. The gunman, who was released from jail in 2025, is now accused in another shooting.
